article.hook: You sketch bold futures faster than anyone can map them. Neptune in Aries makes imagination a sprint, not a slow burn. The world feels like it’s orbiting your next move before you finish thinking it through.
article.lived: Neptune spends about fourteen years here, charging a whole generation’s dreams with urgent, restless energy. We see it in people who launch projects from intuition, racing to make ideals real before doubt sets in. An artist sketches a revolution overnight; a startup founder pivots on a feeling that seems too quick to explain but too right to ignore. The pace turns imagination into action, a rush you can’t press pause on.
article.turn: That speed sharpens confusion into impatience. When the future looks blurry, the urge is to leap harder, not wait longer. Ideas multiply before any one can land, and you end up chasing shadows with a restless, burning desperation. Acting fast doesn’t fix fog - sometimes it just drives you deeper into it.
